(With Poria [茯苓] and winter

Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: Polygala [遠志], flavor bitter, warm. It mainly treats cough and counterflow and damage to the center, supplements insufficiency, removes evil qi, frees the nine orifices, boosts wisdom, makes the ears and eyes acute and bright, prevents forgetfulness, and strengthens the will in mountain valleys.
